assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: Life RPG mobile world scenery background, portrait 2:3. Setting: sunlit meadow, honey green grass, blue distant mountains, warm golden daylight. Cohesive cozy high quality pixel RPG art matching a crafted honey timber and brass trophy cabinet. Crisp chunky pixel clusters around 160x240 logical resolution enlarged cleanly, strong three-tone shading, selective warm highlights, rich teal shadows, broad readable shapes, restrained edge details, NO blurry or fine painted textures. Layout invariant: top 18% distant scenic horizon and sky, lower 82% continuous open level ground seen from a slightly elevated front view. Keep five future building footprints and central character area completely empty: centers at (23%,25%), (77%,25%), (19%,57%), (81%,57%), (50%,84%), plus center(50%,51%). Ground texture is subtle with decorative details ONLY along outermost 7% borders. NO buildings, paths, roads, pedestals, platforms, circular clearings, spots, UI, text, characters, trophies or objects in the central playable area. The app overlays five building spots itself. Entire frame filled, opaque background. Beautiful polished pixel-game environment, no shelf or cabinet in scene.
